title: Are you emotionally exhausted or emotionally disconnected?
intro: Sometimes emotional overload doesn't feel intense anymore. It feels quiet. Flat. Disconnected. Emotional numbing can happen when your nervous system has been under stress for too long. This check-in is designed to help you understand how emotional exhaustion and disconnection may currently be affecting you.

options.text: Emotionally disconnected even while functioning normally
Like I'm hiding how much I'm struggling internally

questions.text: When stress builds up, I usually:

options.text: Pretend I'm okay even when I'm not
I'm going through the motions emotionally
I need space away from people
I don't fully feel present mentally
Stress has drained my emotional energy
People don't fully see how overwhelmed I feel

questions.text: People around me probably see me as:
What do you need most right now?

options.text: A safe space to be honest emotionally

a.description: You are still functioning day-to-day, but emotionally disconnected from yourself and others. You show up — but part of you isn't fully there.

b.description: You pull away emotionally and socially when stress becomes overwhelming. Solitude feels safer than connection right now.

c.description: You feel mentally absent, disconnected, or emotionally not fully there. Your mind has stepped back to protect you from overload.

d.description: Long-term stress and exhaustion have turned into emotional shutdown. Your nervous system has been carrying too much for too long.

e.description: You appear calm or okay externally while struggling internally. You carry a lot quietly — more than the people around you realize.
